The terminology used in the draft guidance is in my view not sufficiently descriptive of the challenges facing the use of HCT/Ps.

There is also the question of the use of autologous cells vs. allogeneic cells whether for adipose tissue or homologous us.

Autologous adipose tissue has been used by cosmetic surgeons for many years to "fill" areas on a patient using their own tissue.

Care must be taken when creating new guidances and regulation on the use of these types of tissues for treatment or study that may drive potentially useful therapies away from study and drive potentially harmful practices under ground, perhaps under the guise of "cosmetic surgery".
